lines: Perumal Ramamurthy Srinivasan, an Investor Selling Shareholder, can sell up to 6,750 shares in the offer for sale, bringing up to ₹0.91 crore (estimate, if all offered shares are sold; employee-portion shares sell at a discount, so actual proceeds are slightly lower).
The gain is up to ₹0.67 crore before offer expenses and taxes, and they keep an estimated ₹2.13 crore in retained holdings valued at the offer price.
Timing is relevant now because the money is already in hand, as trading started March 11, 2026, and the client would have had liquidity since listing.
Confidence is medium: the name is verified in the seller table, but holdings were found in one section only (promoter_holding).
